scores.round_files_fidelity_rationale: Up 0.1 net. Gained: the version string now comes from the STATUSTEXT banner while the parameter download runs, as in MAVLinkInterface.cs:2005-2021, so check_newer_firmware gets 'ArduCopter V4.5.7 (...)' from a real vehicle and the check is live. The sim also sends a banner on PARAM_REQUEST_LIST (sim.rs:674-676). The check now runs after the parameters, as doConnect does. The prompt is the ShowAgain form with the correct 'SHOWAGAIN_New_Firmware_Copter_4_5_7' key, a 'Show me again?' box and a parsed link. The text is exactly NewFirmwareA + type + ' ' + ver2 + Pleaseup + '[link;...]' with no extra newline. show_again_allows is gone. RALLY_TOTAL is parsed with int.TryParse rules. Lost: (a) app.rs:1470 re-tests should_show on every frame, so unticking 'Show me again?' closes the box on the next frame without OK. C# saves on the tick but keeps the dialog open until OK. (b) firmware_check_after_params and load_wps_after_params are never cleared on Disconnected or on a vehicle change. After a skip_params connect, the first Config 'Refresh Params' runs the whole post-connect block: the firmware check, the switch to Flight Plan with a waypoint read, and the rally fetch. (c) RALLY_TOTAL uses double G15 for every type. C# MAVLinkParam.ToString uses float G7 for REAL32, so a REAL32 2.9999999 gives '3' (fetch) in C# and '2.99999988079071' (no fetch) here. (d) The STATUSTEXT match ignores the component id, which C#'s SubscribeToPacketType(.., sysid, compid) filters on, and only the first of the four branches is ported. (e) version_string lives in CurrentState and is wiped on a vehicle change (link.rs:818), where C# keeps one per MAVState. (f) Not gated on showui. GetMetaDataVersioned, APFirmware's all-format/static/appended Manifest and ConfigArducopter 4.7 are still missing. (g) Settings.GetBoolean semantics are still eq_ignore_ascii_case("false") in show_again.rs:15/47, so an unparsable value shows the box where C# hides it.
scores.ui_ux_rationale: Up 0.1. A real vehicle that runs older firmware now gets Mission Planner's 'New Firmware-Copter x.y.z' box with the 'Show me again?' tick and a 'Release Notes' link, after the parameters. But unticking the box makes it disappear at once, which C# never does. The title is drawn as a bold label inside the modal, not as the window caption, and the already-formatted text goes through i18n::t as a whole, so it can never be translated (C# translates each Strings piece). The title bar (app.rs:1477-1487) still guesses VersionString from the first message starting with 'Ardu'/'PX4' and shows the ChibiOS/NuttX line as SerialString, which is C#'s SoftwareVersions, although cs.version_string now exists. Older gaps are unchanged: no FlightPlanner.Activate on the switch, no ProgressReporterDialogue errors, no rally-distance warning, no automatic geofence download, no markers, no ZoomAndCenterMarkers, no GCSView ports.
scores.features_rationale: Up 0.1. The newer-firmware check works against ArduPilot vehicles now, and a Refresh Params on a normal connect no longer fetches rally points. Still wrong: with skip_params there is no ParamsLoaded, so loadwps, rally and the firmware check never run on connect, and the stale flags fire them on the next Refresh Params instead. With a fresh param cache C# never calls getParamList, so VersionString stays '' and no prompt appears. Here the link always downloads again, so the prompt does appear. With Params_BG, C# runs the post-parameter block at once and reads VersionString during the background download. Here everything waits. The stale awaiting_read after a vehicle change or pending-altitude abort still blocks the deferred rally fetch forever. There is no request id on mission reads. The geofence download and RALLY_LIMIT_KM warning are missing. Integer parameters of 1e7 or more lose digits on save, FFT output is not fftui's, and setWPParams ignores the distance unit.

compile_check.summary: Checked every changed region against its definitions. link.rs:1196: `s` is the write guard from self.shared.write(), which borrows only the field self.shared. self.param_fetch.is_some() reads a different field, the same pattern as the existing self.param_fetch.as_mut() at 1303. text.clone() is taken before text moves into StatusMessage. No test or other code reads version_string as 'x.y.z' (grep finds only app.rs:650). app.rs fields 248-256 have matching initialisers at 359-363. firmware_prompt: Option<show_again::ShowAgain>, and ShowAgain derives Clone (show_again.rs:30). drain_events:524-528: as_ref().and_then(|rx| rx.try_recv().ok()) gives an owned Option<Option<(String, String)>>, then ShowAgain::new(&title, &msg, false) takes &str from &String. Connected arm: the assignments to self.load_wps_after_params, self.rally_after_read and self.firmware_check_after_params, and self.toasts.info, are disjoint from pl (&mut self.settings.planner) and link (&self.link). ParamsLoaded: dotnet::int_parse(&str) -> Result<i32, Exception> (dotnet/mod.rs:1466) and double_to_string(f64) -> String (670) are pub, so .ok() then unwrap_or(0) is i32. std::mem::take(&mut self.firmware_check_after_params) is disjoint from link. The thread closure is unchanged from round 66. App::ui:1469-1473: ctx is the egui::Context cloned at 1313, so &ctx matches ShowAgain::ui(&self, &egui::Context, &mut BTreeMap<String, String>). p is a clone, so &mut self.settings.planner does not conflict. should_show(&self.settings.planner, &p.tag) coerces &String to &str. The CentralPanel destructure of self ends at 1465. show_again_allows has no references left (grep). Test 1627-1650: the BTreeMap type is inferred from should_show's parameter, insert with .into() type-checks, and the expectations hold: 'New firmware available\nCopter 4.5.7\nPlease upgrade[link;' is a substring of the formatted message, and key('New Firmware-Copter 4.5.7') = 'SHOWAGAIN_New_Firmware_Copter_4_5_7'. No definite compile error.

findings.summary: R66-03 is mostly fixed. The banner now becomes cs.version_string while the parameters download, so the newer-firmware check works for real vehicles. Remaining: (1) the subscription filters on sysid only, while C# also filters on compid, so a banner-like STATUSTEXT from another component of the same system can overwrite it. (2) Only the copter/rover/plane branch is ported. SoftwareVersions (nuttx/chibios), SerialString (px4v2 or the three-hex-word regex without IOMCU) and FrameString (frame) are not stored. (3) The value lives in CurrentState and is wiped by the vehicle-change reset at link.rs:818, where C# keeps it per MAVState. (4) Not gated on showui. (5) With a fresh param cache C# never calls getParamList, so VersionString stays '' and no prompt appears. The Rust link always downloads again, so the prompt does appear. (6) With Params_BG, C# starts the check at once, racing the background download. Here it always waits. (7) The APFirmware gaps are unchanged: apj-only filtering before GetRelease, no GetListAppend, no static Manifest (a download on every connect), and lenient version parsing where Newtonsoft fails the whole manifest. (8) GetMetaDataVersioned and ConfigArducopter's 4.7 branch are missing. (9) No test drives a STATUSTEXT through the link into the check. The app.rs test still passes a hand-made string.

findings.summary: R66-05 is partly fixed: a Refresh Params after a normal connect no longer fetches rally. New and remaining: (1) firmware_check_after_params and load_wps_after_params are set on Connected and cleared only by a ParamsLoaded. They survive Disconnected and a vehicle change. After a skip_params connect (no ParamsLoaded), the first Config 'Refresh Params' runs the whole doConnect block: the firmware check, the switch to Flight Plan with a waypoint read, and the rally fetch. After a vehicle switch before the first download finishes, the block runs for the other vehicle. (2) With skip_params the block never runs on connect. (3) RALLY_TOTAL (642) formats every type with double G15. C#'s MAVLinkParam.ToString uses ((float)this).ToString() (G7) for REAL32, so a REAL32 near-integer such as 2.9999999 parses as 3 in C# and fails here. Use p.ptype and dotnet::float_to_string for REAL32. (4) A stale awaiting_read after OperationError (link.rs:804, 605) still blocks the deferred rally fetch forever, and there is no request id on mission reads. (5) No FlightPlanner Activate on the switch. (6) '== "True"' instead of bool.TryParse. (7) The Geo-Fence/Rally context Downloads still fill lists C# discards. (8) There are no tests for the ordering, the flags or read_busy.

verdict: No definite compile error. link.rs reads self.param_fetch while the shared write guard is held, which borrows a different field, the same pattern the file already uses at 1303. The new app.rs fields have initialisers. The ShowAgain::ui call gets &egui::Context and &mut planner from a cloned prompt. int_parse and double_to_string exist and are pub. No reference to show_again_allows is left. R66-03 is substantially fixed: the version string is now the STATUSTEXT banner captured during the parameter download, as getParamListAsync does, so the newer-firmware check finally works against a real vehicle and runs after the parameters. R66-04 is substantially fixed: the prompt is the ShowAgain form with the C# key, the 'Show me again?' box, a parsed link and the exact Strings text. The round adds two defects. App::ui re-tests should_show every frame, so unticking 'Show me again?' closes the box at once. The connect flags are never cleared on disconnect, skip_params or a vehicle change, so a later Refresh Params can switch to Flight Plan, read waypoints, fetch rally points and run the firmware check. RALLY_TOTAL uses double G15 where C# uses float G7 for REAL32. Only one of the four STATUSTEXT branches is ported, with no compid filter, and the title bar still ignores the new version string. No owned file was ported. Ported lines stay at 27,302 / 479,014 (5.7%), and the cap stays 1.6. Awarded 1.3; round-file fidelity 6.1; UI/UX 2.4; features 3.3.
